svg.title: JavaScript tools from 2006 to 2026
svg.desc: A timeline. 2006, jQuery: change elements the same way in every browser. 2010, Backbone and AngularJS: models, views, and two-way binding. 2013, React: the page as a function of data, built from components. 2014, Vue: templates that track what they read. 2016, Angular, Svelte, and Next.js: a rewrite, a compiler, and a framework built on React. 2021, Solid 1.0: signals update only what changed. 2026, today: all of them are still in use.
svg.text: jQuery change elements the same way in every browser
Backbone, AngularJS models, views, two-way binding
React: the page as a function of data, in components
Vue templates that track what they read
Angular, Svelte, Next.js rewrite, compiler, meta-framework
Solid 1.0 signals update only what changed
Today every one of these is still running somewhere
